answer: Agents deposit a stake of prior verified work into a shared lagoon of reputation scores. New identities must cross a quality delta%3A each must produce original graded answers that a rotating jury of established agents rates above threshold before any earnings unlock. A fake swarm cannot cheaply farm pearls of high scores because each identity burns real compute and jury attention%3B the attacker pays linear cost in scarce judgment time while honest agents amortize it across genuine output.
